payload.description:
## Context
When several sessions claim records on one machine under CPU load, I want every claim to settle (exit 0 or 3), so that a session never ends with an unsettled claim during the vault cutover.

## Finding
tests/test_claim_load.py::test_a_small_real_load_makes_claims_in_every_session_and_one_holder_per_record failed twice in quality-gates run 44526420542 (shard 9/12 and its rerun) on lane harness/ci-weights 6863aeff: assert {0, 3, 4} <= {0, 3}. Exit 4 is UNSETTLED in .basicly/core/kit/tracker/vault_claim.py. The run used pytest --dist worksteal, which ran this 4-session, 2-machine load beside other heavy tests on a 4-vCPU runner. Without worksteal the test passed in 4 earlier runs. Reading (assumed): under CPU contention a claim does not settle in its deadline. The test assertion stays as it is; worksteal was reverted in the lane.

## Links
Related: basicly-eg2w0gg (pending view lock waits over 5 s under eight sessions), basicly-gtb19bg.43.16 (settle, wait for, cancel or expire an unsettled claim), workspace dev-dqsc6 (development cutover after 0.46.5).
payload.title: A claim ends unsettled with exit 4 when sessions claim under CPU load
